translations.literal: Yongzheng 1, guimao year
translations.idiomatic: The first year of Yongzheng, guimao

translations.literal: Tenth month, day guiyou: Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guiyou day, he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月癸卯左副都御史。三月壬寅遷。五月己卯左副都御史。七月遷。甲辰代。

translations.literal: First month, day guimao: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Third month, day renyin: transferred. Fifth month, day jimao: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Seventh month: transferred. Day jiachen: replacement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on guimao day, he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the third month, on renyin day, he was transferred. In the fifth month, on jimao day, he was again Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the seventh month he was transferred; on jiachen day he succeeded as replacement.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午遷。九月丙午左副都御史。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiawu: transferred. Ninth month, day bingwu: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiawu day, he was transferred. In the ninth month, on bingwu day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯免。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guimao: removed from office. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao day, he was removed from office as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 2, jiachen year
translations.idiomatic: The second year of Yongzheng, jiachen

translations.literal: Third month, day jiawu: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiawu day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月遷。五月癸未左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month: transferred. Fifth month, day guiwei: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was transferred. In the fifth month, on guiwei day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 3, yisi year
translations.idiomatic: The third year of Yongzheng, yisi

translations.literal: Removed from office. Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed from office as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥遷。左都御史。十一月革。甲子左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guihai: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month: dismissed from office. Day jiazi: Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai day, he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief. In the eleventh month he was dismissed from office; on jiazi day he was again Left Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: First month, day renxu: Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on renxu day, he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen day, he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳左副都御史。乙丑遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Day yichou: transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingsi day, he was Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. On yichou day he was transferred and again became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯假免。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guimao: granted leave and removed from office. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guimao day, he was granted leave and removed as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申降。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: demoted. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wushen day, he was demoted from Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 4, bingwu year
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of Yongzheng, bingwu

translations.literal: Fifth month: concurrently Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he also served as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 遷。二月甲子左都御史。九月丙午遷。暫署。癸丑署。

translations.literal: Transferred. Second month, day jiazi: Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day bingwu: transferred. Temporarily acting. Day guichou: acting.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred. In the second month, on jiazi day, he became Left Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, on bingwu day, he was transferred. He served temporarily in an acting capacity; on guichou day he was again acting.

sentences.zh: 四月解。五月丁酉左都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month: relieved. Fifth month, day dingyou: Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he was relieved of duty. In the fifth month, on dingyou day, he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月己巳革。左副都御史。七月戊戌遷。左副都御史。十月遷。乙卯左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day jisi: dismissed from office. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Seventh month, day wuxu: transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Tenth month: transferred. Day yimao: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on jisi day, he was dismissed as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the seventh month, on wuxu day, he was transferred and again became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the tenth month he was transferred; on yimao day he was again Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 5, dingwei year
translations.idiomatic: The fifth year of Yongzheng, dingwei

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳理藩院左侍郎。十月庚寅調。代。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi: Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Tenth month, day gengyin: transferred. Replacement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guisi day, he became Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. In the tenth month, on gengyin day, he was transferred and succeeded as replacement.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳理藩院右侍郎。十月庚寅遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi: Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Tenth month, day gengyin: transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guisi day, he became Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. In the tenth month, on gengyin day, he was transferred and again served as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月乙巳革。丙辰左都御史。十二月戊戌卒。壬寅代。

translations.literal: First month, day yisi: dismissed from office. Day bingchen: Left Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day wuxu: died. Day renyin: replacement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on yisi day, he was dismissed from office. On bingchen day he became Left Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, he died; on renyin day a replacement succeeded.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰降。左副都御史。十二月壬寅遷。

translations.literal: Third month, day renchen: demoted. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day renyin: transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen day, he was demoted from Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, on renyin day, he was transferred.

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 6, wushen year
translations.idiomatic: The sixth year of Yongzheng, wushen

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guimao: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guimao day, he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月遷。戊子左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month: transferred. Day wuzi: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was transferred. On wuzi day he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰宗室左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen: imperial-clan Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen day, an imperial-clan member was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 正月丙子左副都御史。八月甲午遷。九月甲戌左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day bingzi: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eighth month, day jiawu: transferred. Ninth month, day jiaxu: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on bingzi day, he was Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the eighth month, on jiawu day, he was transferred. In the ninth month, on jiaxu day, he was again Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午革。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiawu: dismissed from office. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiawu day, he was dismissed as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 7, jiyou year
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of Yongzheng, jiyou

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌遷。四月乙未左副都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: transferred. Fourth month, day yiwei: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu day, he was transferred. In the fourth month, on yiwei day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 宗室十一月丁酉遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Imperial clan. Eleventh month, day dingyou: transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial-clan member: in the eleventh month, on dingyou day, he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌革。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu: dismissed from office. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu day, he was dismissed as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 8, gengxu year
translations.idiomatic: The eighth year of Yongzheng, gengxu

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai day, he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guihai: transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guihai day, he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌遷。九月己丑左副都御史。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu: transferred. Ninth month, day jichou: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renxu day, he was transferred. In the ninth month, on jichou day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 9, xinhai year
translations.idiomatic: The ninth year of Yongzheng, xinhai

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉遷。壬辰左都御史。九月丁卯遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day yiyou: transferred. Day renchen: Left Censor-in-Chief. Ninth month, day dingmao: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiyou day, he was transferred. On renchen day he became Left Censor-in-Chief. In the ninth month, on dingmao day, he was transferred and again served as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑遷。左都御史。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinchou: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinchou day, he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯遷。戊子左副都御史。十二月丁未降。代。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingmao: transferred. Day wuzi: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day dingwei: demoted. Replacement.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao day, he was transferred. On wuzi day he became Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, on dingwei day, he was demoted and succeeded by a replacement.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥革。二月己亥左副都御史。

translations.literal: First month, day yihai: dismissed from office. Second month, day jihai: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, on yihai day, he was dismissed from office. In the second month, on jihai day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 10, renzi year
translations.idiomatic: The tenth year of Yongzheng, renzi

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌遷。乙未理藩院左侍郎。十二月庚午革。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingxu: transferred. Day yiwei: Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Twelfth month, day gengwu: dismissed from office. Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingxu day, he was transferred. On yiwei day he became Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. In the twelfth month, on gengwu day, he was dismissed from that post.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未遷。理藩院右侍郎。十二月庚午遷。理藩院右侍郎。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. Twelfth month, day gengwu: transferred. Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei day, he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. In the twelfth month, on gengwu day, he was transferred and again served as Right Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未遷。十月戊午左都御史。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day dingwei: transferred. Tenth month, day wuwu: Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingwei day, he was transferred. In the tenth month, on wuwu day, he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰遷。癸巳左副都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengchen: transferred. Day guisi: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengchen day, he was transferred. On guisi day he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 遷。六月丙寅左副都御史。

translations.literal: Transferred. Sixth month, day bingyin: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred. In the sixth month, on bingyin day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 11, guichou year
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh year of Yongzheng, guichou

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申遷。左都御史。四月乙卯遷。左都御史。十二月己未遷。代。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Fourth month, day yimao: transferred. Left Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day jiwei: transferred. Replacement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen day, he was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief. In the fourth month, on yimao day, he was transferred and again served as Left Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, he was transferred and succeeded by a replacement.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子遷。左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiazi: transferred. Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiazi day, he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 四月乙卯遷。壬申左副都御史。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day yimao: transferred. Day renshen: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yimao day, he was transferred. On renshen day he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 九月遷。十月壬戌左副都御史。十二月丁卯遷。

translations.literal: Ninth month: transferred. Tenth month, day renxu: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day dingmao: transferred.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he was transferred. In the tenth month, on renxu day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, on dingmao day, he was transferred.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 12, jiayin year
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year of Yongzheng, jiayin

sentences.zh: 十二月遷。理藩院左侍郎。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: transferred. Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was transferred to Left Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌遷。四月丁卯左副都御史。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuxu: transferred. Fourth month, day dingmao: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu day, he was transferred. In the fourth month, on dingmao day, he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰左副都御史。四月丁亥遷。六月丙午左副都御史。十一月遷。丁亥代。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Fourth month, day dinghai: transferred. Sixth month, day bingwu: Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month: transferred. Day dinghai: replacement.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingchen day, he was Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the fourth month, on dinghai day, he was transferred. In the sixth month, on bingwu day, he was again Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the eleventh month he was transferred; on dinghai day a replacement succeeded.

translations.literal: Yongzheng 13, yimao year
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth year of Yongzheng, yimao

sentences.zh: 十月丁丑革。戊寅署左都御史。十一月庚戌左都御史。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingchou: dismissed from office. Day wuyin: acting Left Censor-in-Chief. Eleventh month, day gengxu: Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingchou day, he was dismissed from office. On wuyin day he served as acting Left Censor-in-Chief. In the eleventh month, on gengxu day, he was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅差。署左副都御史。十二月庚辰補。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuyin: detached on assignment. Acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. Twelfth month, day gengchen: formally appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wuyin day, he was detached on special assignment and served as acting Left Vice Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, he received formal appointment.
